main_text.p: thodum diligenter abs te obseruatam, scriptum hoc tuum tam erit hostibus veritatis aduersum, quam doctis lectoribus gratum, & studiosa iuuentuti utile, quam certe ad hanc recte disputandi rationem magis ac magis excitari oportet. Bene vale, vir eximie, cum universo charissimorum fratrum ac sanctissimorum coetu, quorum sacris laboribus utinam Dominus ille & Seruator noster magis ac magis benedicat. Geneuæ Pridie Nonas Augusti, anno ultimæ Dei patientiæ 1586.

page.notes: The running head reads "EPISTOLA." The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The date line is printed as "1586" with spaced digits, transcribed as printed. The first line's opening word "thodum" is a fragment and kept as printed; the text in the first line is partly obscured by the scan edge and some words are uncertain.
